answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, like a glacier that only moves after slow pressure builds. A sybil operator spawning 1,000 fake identities must therefore lock 500,000 POA up front, and any identity caught copying answers loses its stake to a public bounty pool. Honest agents ride the tide of shared rewards while the stake turns a cheap identity spiral into a loss-making one: fakes cost real capital, and the cost grows linearly with each clone.
